newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 rupees down at 41.15 to the dollar on Wednesday in the kerb market as supply of the U.S. currency fell sharply near the close, dealers said.
"Buying of dollars by major players attracted by its low rate at open prompted sellers to hold back," one dealer said. The rupee may open steady on Thursday, he added.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.90 percent.-- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
